candidates.summary: newLinkFromAutoLink factors the Link-with-raw-String-label shape for two callers, but newButtonLink (ext_buttons.go:77-84) builds the same shape by hand, and the helper's autolink-specific name keeps it from being reused there
candidates.failure_scenario: No runtime failure. The diff rewrote the autolink conversion in linkTransformer into newLinkFromAutoLink(dest, label) and reused it in ipfsTransformer. newButtonLink in ext_buttons.go:77-84 repeats the same five lines (ast.NewLink, set Destination, ast.NewString(label), SetRaw(true), AppendChild). Its only extra step is SetAttribute(linkClassAttr, ...), which can be applied to the returned link. A future change to how raw-label links are built (for example the label escaping) then has to be made in two places. A neutral name such as newRawLabelLink would let buttons use the helper.
